name: Local subtitle folder
description: A subtitle provider that searches a folder on the server (for example a shared archive of Romanian subtitles) by IMDb id or title. Files are named like "tt0133093 The Matrix 1999 BluRay-GROUP.ro.srt" or kept in folders named after the IMDb id; .zip/.rar archives work too.
author: MediaMax

settings.label: Subtitle folder
settings.help: Absolute path on the server. Searched recursively (up to 5 levels).
